content: तालः [तल् एव अण्] .²1 The palmyra tree, <ls>Bhāg. 8. 2. 12</ls>; विधिवशात्तालस्य मूलं गतः <ls>Bh. 2. 90</ls>; <ls>R. 15. 23</ls>. .²2 A banner formed of the palm. .²3 Slapping or clapping the hands together, the noise made by it; तलतालांश्च वादयन् <ls>Mb. 3. 178. 17</ls>; <ls>Māl. 5. 23</ls>. .²4 Flapping in general; विस्तारितः कुञ्जरकर्णतालैः <ls>R. 7. 39</ls>. .²5 Flapping of the ears of an elephant. .²6 Beating time (in music); करकिसलयतालैर्मुग्धया नर्त्यमानम् <ls>U. 3. 10</ls>; <ls>Me. 81</ls>. .²7 A musical instrument made of bell-metal, <ls>Bhāg. 8. 15. 21</ls>; उषसि स गजयूथकर्णतालैः पटुपटहध्वनिभिर्विनीतनिद्रः <ls>R. 9. 71</ls>. .²8 The palm of the hand. .²9 A lock, bolt. .²10 The hilt of a sword. .²11 An epithet of Śiva. .²12 (In prosody) A trochee. .²13 A particular measure of height; <ls>Rām. 6</ls>. .²14 A short span; a span measured by the thumb and the middle finger. .²15 A dance; <ls>S. D. 6</ls>. .{@-लम्@} .²1 The nut of the palmyra tree. .²2 Yellow orpiment.
